{'test_behavior': "Test that getIndexedPropertyLength works correctly when the property has a regular read method.\nThe original test fails because IndexedPropertyDescriptor constructor throws IntrospectionException\ndue to type mismatch between indexed and non-indexed methods. The fix is to ensure the types match:\ngetItems returns List and getItem returns String, which is compatible.\nHowever, the constructor expects the indexed read method to return the component type of the array\nreturned by the non-indexed read method.
